Backend: 6/6 pytest passed (forum required CRUD + subset enforcement, public GET fields[].required boolean, public POST 400 validation with Azerbaijani error message + 200 success path, sales-leads with project_id appears in /project-events/{id}/sales). action_items: Optional polish: Add <DialogDescription> across Dialog modals to silence Radix accessibility warning (carried over from iter_45).
Optional: Backend POST /api/sales-leads — consider returning 201 instead of 200 for resource creation (current returns 200 on success — minor REST nit, not blocking).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py forum required-fields endpoint /api/public/form/{token} POST: validation correctly uses field labels in Azerbaijani; isinstance handling for blank-list and string strip is solid. Consider also rejecting list-of-empty-strings (e.g., [''] or whitespace-only items) as 'is_blank' for robustness.

PUT /api/forum/fields silently drops invalid required keys (subset filter). Acceptable defensive behavior, but consider returning a warning in the response body listing dropped keys so admins know about typos.
Settings.jsx forumRequired state: when a field is unchecked from forumEnabled, it is correctly removed from forumRequired (line 1110). Good defensive UX.
PublicForm.jsx red asterisk rendering — covers text/select/date/textarea/file types as claimed; verified visually with 2 asterisks.
Assembly.jsx CarryOverPicker (line ~14) — fetches /api/assemblies on open via parent state. Verify performance if there are >100 past meetings (consider date-based pagination or lazy load).
Assembly.jsx PersonTags search — controlled local state with case-insensitive filter; accessible. Good.
ProjectDetail.jsx — TABLE_CONFIGS hardcodes column labels; if user wants column-rename via Settings, this would need refactor to dynamic config. Acceptable for current scope.
Backend file is now 6152 lines (was 6131 in iter 45) — continued growth. Consider router extraction (companies, invitations, settings, sales-leads, forum) — past flagged.
